rows.body: I just finished my first tube from the Sephora sale earlier this year. I bought the bigger one this time because I love it so much. It isn’t scented, it’s the perfect texture on my skin and it has never irritated my skin at all. I love it so much and unfortunately it’s worth the price. 😅

On my second big girl 100 oz tube. This WILL BE your favorite moisturizer hands down. Comes with a metal turn key to get every bit of this Dieux instant angel glow. I use day and night and it’s instant radiance in the morning not maybe I see something….YOU SEE THE DIFFERENCE! 😍 LOVE Dieux

Yes, this works very well on my skin. I also like the texture of it than the Prequel ointment one. However, this packaging is not the best. If I not careful enough, the product will get push out when put the cab on
This product has saved my very dry skin. I will never go without it because tretinion dried my skin out but this product saved it.
This is my second bottle was getting really low and was afraid I was going to run out. Absolutely love this stuff do not want to live without it.
Best purchase of the year! This moisturizer kicks ass! I'm always glowing now Before and after picture
